ko.executive_summary: NVIDIA dominates custom AI accelerator market with record $96B revenue in Q2 2026, though emerging competitive pressures emerge from OpenAI's Jalapeño claiming superior performance against Blackwell, and divergent market valuations between Broadcom and AMD suggest uncertainty about alternative chip winners.
key_facts: NVIDIA Q2 2026 revenue: $96B
OpenAI Jalapeño positioned as superior to NVIDIA Blackwell accelerators
Market pricing Broadcom and AMD differently despite same AI boom exposure

implications.text: Hyperscaler internal designs (OpenAI Jalapeño) emerging as performance alternative to NVIDIA, though NVIDIA CEO expresses 100% confidence in continued institutional adoption
Broadcom and AMD valuations diverging suggests market differentiation by data center design-in likelihood or margin profiles
NVIDIA's $96B quarterly revenue reflects continued dominance despite custom silicon and competitive pressure from Broadcom, AMD

ko.counterpoint: NVIDIA's confidence in sustained market share may underestimate custom silicon adoption curves if performance parity is achieved

ko.executive_summary: AI-driven data center demand shatters traditional memory industry boom-bust cycles, with Micron reporting 50% supply deficit. India advances semiconductor ecosystem from electronics manufacturing to integrated chip production, while advanced packaging research in SiC and wafer handling technologies supports broader infrastructure modernization.
key_facts: Micron: Data center memory demand exceeds supply by 50%
India transitioning to semiconductor manufacturing focus beyond electronics assembly
Wafer handling equipment market outlook through 2035
TU Wien/Silvaco research on aluminum dopant activation in 4H-SiC

implications.text: 50% demand-supply imbalance in data center DRAM/HBM extends pricing power and capital expenditure cycles for memory suppliers
India's semiconductor ambitions create new packaging and assembly capacity outside traditional Taiwan-South Korea duopoly
SiC packaging research and wafer handling improvements support next-generation power and RF applications in data center infrastructure

ko.counterpoint: 50% supply deficit may be temporary if hyperscaler CapEx cycles normalize or custom silicon reduces HBM demand intensity
